description: Daily aggregated energy (kWh) per park in wide format

index.name: date
index.description: Daily timestamp (local timezone Europe/Athens), normalized to midnight

columns.description: Each column represents a park_id, values are daily energy in kWh

source.transformation: load_daily_energy_wide() - aggregates 15min power readings to daily energy

refresh_strategy.logic: Process silver partitions by month, track last processed date, append new days only

partitioning.description: Single wide parquet file per refresh, partitioned implicitly by date in index

deduplication.logic: Track last processed date to ensure no duplicate aggregations

unit_conversion.unknown: Treated as kW with interval scaling
